verifyEmailTemplate.subject: Verify your email for Snippet
verifyEmailTemplate.title: Confirm it’s you
verifyEmailTemplate.body: Tap the button to verify %EMAIL% for Snippet. Your saved cards start syncing as soon as it’s done.
verifyEmailTemplate.footnote: Didn’t sign up for Snippet? You can ignore this email.

resetPasswordTemplate.subject: Reset your Snippet password
resetPasswordTemplate.title: Choose a new password
resetPasswordTemplate.body: We got a request to reset the password for %EMAIL%. Tap the button to choose a new one. The link works for one hour.
resetPasswordTemplate.footnote: Didn’t ask for this? Ignore this email and your password stays the same.

changeEmailTemplate.subject: Your Snippet sign-in email was changed
changeEmailTemplate.title: Your sign-in email changed
changeEmailTemplate.body:
Your Snippet sign-in email was changed from %EMAIL% to %NEW_EMAIL%.

If you made this change, you’re all set. If not, undo it now and then reset your password.
changeEmailTemplate.footnote: We sent this to your previous address so you can spot changes you didn’t make.
